question: The Bilderberg Conference from 12–15 June 2025 took place in _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Stockholm**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Bilderberg Conference** for the year **2025** is scheduled to take place from **12 June to 15 June 2025**.
 
• The meeting is hosted in **Stockholm**, the capital city of **Sweden**. This location is chosen to provide a secure and private environment for international dialogue.
 
• This annual event is a **private conference** established to foster discussion between **Europe** and **North America**. It typically gathers **120 to 150** of the world's most influential individuals.
 
• Participants include **political leaders**, **experts** from industry, **finance**, **academia**, and the **media**. The **2025** session continues the tradition of addressing critical global issues in an informal setting.
 
• The agenda for such meetings usually covers broad themes like **geopolitical shifts**, the **global economic system**, **technological advancements**, and **international security**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Historical Background**: 
 
 
• The first conference was held in **May 1954** at the **Hotel de Bilderberg** in **Oosterbeek**, **Netherlands**.
 
• It was initiated by **Prince Bernhard of the Netherlands** and Polish politician **Józef Retinger** to promote **Atlanticism** and prevent another world war.
 
 
 
• **The Chatham House Rule**: 
 
 
• The conference is famous for its strict privacy, operating under the **Chatham House Rule**.
 
• This means that while participants are free to use the information received, they cannot reveal the identity or the affiliation of the speakers or any other participant.
 
 
 
• **Governance and Funding**: 
 
 
• The conference is organized by a **Steering Committee** composed of members from different countries, typically serving **four-year terms**.
 
• There is no permanent staff, and the annual meeting is funded through private contributions; participants generally cover their own travel and accommodation expenses.
 
 
 
• **Selection of Participants**: 
 
 
• Attendees are invited by the **Steering Committee** and participate as individuals rather than in an official capacity (e.g., as a **Government Minister** or **CEO**).
 
• The diversity of the group is intended to represent a wide range of viewpoints and expertise from the **North Atlantic** community.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **No Official Output**: Unlike the **G7** or **G20** summits, the **Bilderberg Conference** does not result in a final communique, no resolutions are proposed, and no votes are taken.
 
• **Global Influence**: Because the attendees include high-ranking **EU officials**, **heads of state**, and leaders of **multinational corporations**, the discussions are often seen as influential in shaping long-term **global policy** trends.
 
• **Host Country Tradition**: **Sweden** has a long history of hosting significant international diplomatic events. By hosting the **2025** conference in **Stockholm**, the country reinforces its status as a key hub for **Nordic** and **European** affairs.
 
• **Transparency vs. Privacy**: While the group publishes a list of participants and a broad list of topics discussed shortly before each meeting, the actual contents of the debates remain confidential to encourage **candor** and **openness**.
